masterRequest.name: Picker's Hollow - Charcoal Welding Mask - master
masterRequest.description: A single EMPTY classic industrial WELDING FACE SHIELD, front South view, low top-down pixel-art RPG equipment reference. SAME unisex manufactured model for both player bodies. Broad squared rectangular faceplate, nearly square proportions, flat top edge with small chamfered corners, straight parallel sides, broad flat lower chin edge with tiny clipped corners. Matte dark charcoal gray shell, quiet medium-gray edge highlights. ONE clean wide RECTANGULAR dark desaturated green glass viewing window in the upper half, visibly framed by a straight black rectangular rim on all four sides. Front surface below window is one broad uninterrupted flat gray panel. Small dark side hinge studs. Recognizable ordinary flip-down welding mask; not a rounded head, not a robot face, not a bucket/space/knight helmet. No orange, rust, gold, eye holes, mouth, nostrils, expressive eyebrows, pointed chin, round oval silhouette, flared cheeks, gender styling, texture noise or glow. Small native equipment sprite: faceplate about 18px wide and 18px high near x15..33 y6..24, centered over where a human head would be, with generous untouched transparent space below. Crisp 1px black outline and 3-tone grayscale shading with small dark green glass area. No person, body, mannequin, neck, ground or shadow. Transparent 48x64 canvas.
